Question 2

Consider the ellipse centered at the origin with horizontal radius 8 and vertical radius 5, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for θ∈[0,2π), traverse the ellipse once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point A(8,0)?

a
x=8cos⁡θ,y=5sin⁡θ
b
x=8sin⁡θ,y=5cos⁡θ
c
x=25sin⁡θ,y=64cos⁡θ
d
x=5sin⁡θ,y=8cos⁡θ
e
x=5cos⁡θ,y=8sin⁡θ
